description: Use this when you need the list of URLs on a website, not their content: to see a site's pages, find a section, or pick pages to scrape. Can rank URLs by `search_query` and filter them with glob patterns. Returns URLs only. To get the content of many pages from the site, use create_crawl.

search_query.description: Optional search query to filter URLs (e.g., "blog").

top_n.description: Optional limit for number of URLs returned.

url.description: Website URL to extract links from.

name: create_map
title: Create Map
